short: The library, the Storybook stories, the old gallery, the checks
is: The package's code in five parts: `lib/` is the public entry, `stories/` holds the component gallery's Storybook stories, docs pages and frame, `routes/` hosts the old Kit gallery and `gallery/` is its frame (both built until Storybook replaces them; the token pages' parts in `gallery/` stay), and `checks/` are specs that guard the package's own shape.
conventions: Specs sit beside the code they test (`*.spec.ts` in node, `*.svelte.spec.ts` in real Chromium); `expect.requireAssertions` is on.

A gallery page registers itself with a `meta.ts` under `routes/components/<slug>/` exporting `meta` (a title and one of the groups in `gallery/groups.ts`); the registry finds it by glob and turns away, rather than throws on, a malformed, duplicate or misplaced one.
The gallery's user-visible words live in `gallery/groups.ts` and the frame; the frame is imported through the `$gallery` alias.

Reserved inside `lib/`: `motion/` (the one place motion libraries may be imported), `environment/` (the one home of Svelte's context, the seam components read their moves and sounds through), `lazy/` (the one place heavy libraries load, by dynamic import only) and `styles/tokens.css` (the style scan's one exempt file). `motion/`, `environment/` and `styles/` exist today; `lazy/` does not.

`lib/index.ts` is the whole public surface of the code: the paper lists (`PAPER_MOVES`, `PAPER_CLASSES`), the environment names and `parseSkin`, the token model, Icon with its names, the eleven controls with the link, day and locale mints and their item shapes, the nine surfaces (ToastStack, Card, Badge, Spinner, Skeleton, VisibilityMarker, StatusPill, Avatar and Pin) with their shapes, the feedback action's shape and the picture and pin-point mints (`ImageSrc`, `PinPoint`), and the seam's types and still forms. The styles are a separate side-effect entry, `@zurfur/ui/styles` (`lib/styles/index.ts`), and the host may also import `@zurfur/ui/tokens.json` and `@zurfur/ui/tokens.additions.json`.

Only `gallery/skin-store.ts` touches storage, and `localStorage` alone; every other file refuses all storage and `cookie`, and no file reaches the private file store (`navigator.storage`, `getDirectory`). `app.html` holds the gallery's one boot script, pinned by the hash in `gallery/boot-script.ts` and kept out of prettier.
Stories import `@zurfur/ui` by its public entry only, never a path into `lib/` (see `stories/`); `.mdx` files are allowed only under `stories/`.
Each control has a spec, and no control has a gallery page: the component gallery is moving to Storybook, and the gallery here holds the frame and the token pages.

fs.name: app.html
fs.role: the page shell, holding the gallery's one boot script (pinned by hash in gallery/boot-script.ts; kept out of prettier)

fs.name: checks/
fs.role: specs over the package itself: the lint boundary rules and the import tiers, declared imports, forbidden files (only plain files and real folders, read without following links; a backslash in any name refused; server-side, hooks, service-worker and node_modules names tested in every folder of the path, JSX, a runes module (.svelte.ts, .svelte.js) anywhere but lib/motion, and any extension off the list .ts, .svelte, .css, except NODE.inf.json in any folder, app.html at the root and the two token JSON files by exact path), the style and network scans and the readers of the public entry's components and a stories file's meta (scan/), composition (the lego check over every file under src/, read with its table, composition-table.ts: each export simple or composite, owned elements, zf- families and bits-ui names kept to the files the table lists, every stylesheet under lib/ read (one in a styles folder by its row, any other only for the shared families), each family in one stylesheet row and in none when a component styles it in its own style block, the family stylesheets' selectors kept to their own families, a simple file holding Spinner only by the literal kind="glyph", no lib file importing the package entry, no plain .ts file in lib/ but the entry importing or re-exporting a .svelte file (a type-only import included), stories composing and carrying their component's kind; its exceptions only shrink), family-css (no folder under styles/ but controls/ and surfaces/; the seven control and eight surface family stylesheets and their token-only, no-motion rules; only placement on a rule whose target names neither a zf- class nor an element), the seam's moves contract (moves.contract.ts: the rows every moves adapter passes, run against the still forms here and by the adapter's own spec later), public-api (no bits-ui or date-library type crosses the public API), words (every word a control, an icon or a surface shows is a prop; no middle dot, as itself or escaped, and no age-check or ID-check words in lib/, stories/ and the fixtures), load-lint (the `ui-load` block's cases: timers, load starters, inline style from code, media markup, values reaching a style or a loading attribute, prefixed `<svelte:element>` tags; `SVELTE_ELEMENT_FILES` equal to the lego table's `DYNAMIC_ELEMENT`), fixtures (static/ read without following links: only fixtures/, only listed plain SVGs, each on the allow-list), web-imports (web's own lint, read from here: it may import only the packages it declares, never through node_modules or out of its src/), web-disables (no comment in web/src outside buf's protobuf output, lib/server/api/generated/, switches web's import rules off, nor is a bare disable), control-attributes (no shipped control renders an attribute named on… in any letter case, at rest or after a first interaction with its tooltip or menu open; a control with no fixture fails it), the spec harnesses (testing/), serve config (loopback serving, and Kit's inline options read so no file renaming, service worker or svelte config file gets in), tsconfig parity with web, workspace shape and the public entry; the tokens (tokens/: the copy step, the generator, the writer behind `yarn tokens` and their specs), the contrast, fonts, paper and boot-script specs, and the media spec (its own Vitest project, client-media, run after every other, using the narrow emulateMedia command in media-command.ts, which takes only the colour scheme, reduced motion and forced colours); the Storybook checks (storybook-config: the config folder's four files and main.ts's keys; storybook-channel: the server-channel hook; story-imports, story-fixtures, story-coverage (with the Title Case rule over defineMeta titles, story names and fixture titles) and docs-pages over src/stories/, story-fixtures over src/gallery/ too); built-output.ts, run by the gate and CI after every Kit build and, with --storybook, after every Storybook build: it refuses remote URLs a page loads by itself in the built CSS and HTML, any http-equiv but Kit's content-security-policy, ZURFUR_ or DATABASE_URL in any text file, script, handlers, outside references and animation in any SVG, and anything but the listed fixtures in the build's fixtures/ (exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 unreadable); references.ts, run over the screenshot run's reference pictures (shots/__screenshots__) after every update run, and by its spec over the committed ones: exactly <entry id>/<dark|light>.png read without following links, each a plain PNG of at most 1 MiB and 4096 px a side with only IHDR, IDAT and IEND chunks, each CRC checked, the IDAT chunks one run holding one zlib stream that inflates to exactly the bytes IHDR implies, an empty IEND, and nothing after it (exit 0 clean, 1 findings, 2 unreadable)

fs.name: checks/testing/
fs.role: harness components for the control specs: parents that accept changes, an environment probe, the recording environment, a recording tooltip trigger and a scrolling box host

fs.name: gallery/
fs.role: the gallery frame: the registry (page discovery), page meta, the nav groups, GalleryNav, GalleryPage and GalleryState; skin-store.ts (the one file that touches storage), boot-script.ts (the pinned hash of the page shell's boot script), SkinSwitch (the header's Skin switch), GallerySkins (a state in Paper dark and Paper light, handing each copy its skin), GalleryMotion (the moves and cues a control uses, as text, typed to the seam's names so a rename fails `check`), contrast/ (the contrast arithmetic and the declared pairs), usage-text.ts and UsageText (usage lines as text and code, never HTML), token-source.ts (the token model for the pages) and the token pages' parts (TokenModelGate, TokenSection, TokenList, ContrastTable, EasingCurve with easing-curve.ts, FontFaces, MoveSheet)

fs.name: lib/
fs.role: the public entry (index.ts) and the folders behind it: the controls, the icons, the seam (environment/), the paper moves (motion/), the styles and the surfaces

fs.name: routes/
fs.role: the old Kit gallery host, built until Storybook replaces it: the layout (header, nav, main), the index and components/<slug>/ pages, among them the six Tokens and paper pages (colour, type, space-and-shape, shadows, motion-and-sound, paper)

fs.name: stories/
fs.role: the component gallery in Storybook: stories, docs pages, fixtures and the frame
